title: Friendship with Jo Jones and Max Roach
summary: Jo Jones stays at Lovett's house, sent for him to New York after Tilly died, and Max Roach is also a friend.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: When is Jo Jones coming back to Kansas City, soon?
Well no, I don't know. I've been trying to call him. He must of -- I don't think he's in New York right now. He must be out somewhere.
I think he's in Hawaii.
I tried to call him twice.
Does Trummy Young (Unintelligible) -- bring him in?
No. Bartee was here --
Oh yeah, Bartee.
-- in the winter and he spoke -- Jo was going somewhere. I think he said Hawaii or somewhere he was going. I don't know, he might not be but I think he's out of the state.
Well he's a wonderful fellow, man.
Oh Jo, yes.
Yeah, his wife --
I remember him at the Southland in Boston.
Yeah, he sent for me to come to New York on the airplane right away after my wife passed, you know. 'I want you to be here away. I don't want you to stay in that house by yourself'.
You were real close friends.
Oh man, wonderful friends we are.
Everytime he comes, he comes to my house and stays.
I know he does and Max Roach stays with you too when he comes to town?
He doesn't stay at my house, no -- he stays down the MillBox I think somewhere.
I know you and he are great friends.
Oh yes.
